item.title: No One Is Going To Save You
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: We carry this thought in the back of our heads. it is subtle. it is subconscious. it is so invisible that even when you write and write, trying to drag it from the subconscious into the conscious, it refuses to show itself clearly. instead, you only feel the symptoms, the void, the emptiness, the sense of being lost. but beneath all of that, there is something deeply rooted.

item.title: Economical With My Words - Advice
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: when it comes to giving advice, I’ve become economical with my words. I take things slowly, often saying maybe later, or not now.

item.title: A User Manual for Being Close to Me
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: I basically ruined all the friendships I had since I was a kid, and it is me who is the problem, not the people, although I kept myself busy to the point where I don’t feel it most of the time, alongside guilt and fear of making new friendships.

item.title: Before You Heal Someone
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description:
Consider how hard it is to change yourself and you will understand how foolish it is to think you can change someone else.
— Matthew Hussey

item.title: Learning the Truth About How I Love
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: your growth is directly proportional to the amount of truth you are willing to accept about yourself.

item.title: Asking For Help
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: What is the bravest thing you’ve ever said? Help. Asking for help isn’t giving up. It’s refusing to give up. ― Charlie Mackesy

item.title: Adding New Friends System
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description:
I get asked:
